data.name: Agonizing Touch Stain
data.description: Both of your hands wither to nearly skeletal appendages, and your emotions dim towards the coldness of undeath. You take a -2 penalty on attacks with manufactured weapons. Your spells with somatic or emotion (Occult Adventures 144) components have a 5%% failure chance. This stacks with any spell failure chances you incur from other sources.
